run_barycentric_clip_benchmark: run the barycentric clipping benchmark comparing CUDA and PyTorch rasterization performance on icosphere meshes
run_baryclip_cuda: run the CUDA-accelerated barycentric clipping rasterization benchmark with configurable mesh count and image size
run_baryclip_pytorch: run the pure PyTorch barycentric clipping benchmark using manual coordinate clipping and z-buffer interpolation
review_bm_barycentric_clip: review the benchmark function that generates test cases across mesh counts, ico levels, and image sizes
test_baryclip_cuda: test the CUDA rasterizer with barycentric coordinate clipping enabled on icosphere meshes
